The '''Alaspin casino''' was bombed by the [[Kerestian/Legends|Kerestian]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[Limna Yith]]. The attack buried hundreds of patrons inside, including the leaders of the [[Kassandre crime family]].<ref name="SSR">''[[Secrets of the Sisar Run]]''</ref>
